## Copy number profile

```{r cn-setup}
has_any_ascat_plot = !is.null(outputs$ascat_plots) &&
  any(vapply(outputs$ascat_plots, function(x) !is.null(x) && file.exists(x), logical(1)))
# Copy-number section module (R/sections/cna.R); NULL when no CN output was found
cna = SECTION_DATA[["cna"]]
cna_profiles   = if (!is.null(cna)) cna$profiles else list()
cna_wakhan_dir = if (!is.null(cna)) cna$wakhan_dir else NA_character_
cna_has_wakhan = !is.na(cna_wakhan_dir) && dir.exists(cna_wakhan_dir)
cna_solutions  = if (!is.null(cna) && nrow(cna$solutions) > 0) cna$solutions else NULL
embed_full     = identical(embed, "full")
```

```{r wakhan-profile-helper}
# One static haplotype-resolved profile (cna_profile_plot(), R/sections/cna.R) as a
# captioned figure. Replaces the embedded Wakhan Plotly HTML (tens of MB per report).
wakhan_profile_figure = function(pr) {
  p = cna_profile_plot(pr$segments, chromosomes, chrom_lens, labels = c("HP1", "HP2"))
  if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
  fmt = function(x) if (is.na(x)) "NA" else trimws(formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 3))
  min_w = round(CNA_PROFILE_MIN_FRAC * sum(as.numeric(chrom_lens[chromosomes]), na.rm = TRUE), -5)
  tags$figure(
    class = "report-figure cna-profile",
    embed_svg_plot(p, width = 10, height = 3.1,
                   alt = paste0("Wakhan rank ", pr$rank, " haplotype-resolved copy-number profile"),
                   class = "cna-profile__img"),
    tags$figcaption(class = "report-figure__caption",
      paste0("Rank ", pr$rank, " solution (purity ", fmt(pr$purity), ", ploidy ", fmt(pr$ploidy),
             "): integer copy number per haplotype, fainter = lower Wakhan confidence. ",
             "Segments above ", CNA_PROFILE_YCAP, " are drawn at the cap with their value marked; ",
             "segments shorter than ", fmt_bp(min_w), " are widened so they stay visible."))
  )
}
```

```{r wakhan-profile, eval=length(cna_profiles) > 0}
wakhan_profile_figure(cna_profiles[[1]])
```

```{r wakhan-originals, eval=cna_has_wakhan}
n_more = max(0L, length(cna_profiles) - 1L)
heatmap_name = if (!is.null(cna) && !is.na(cna$wakhan_heatmap))
                 file.path("wakhan", basename(cna$wakhan_heatmap)) else
                 "wakhan/*_heatmap_ploidy_purity.html"
tags$p(class = "table-footnote",
  if (n_more > 0 && !embed_full)
    tagList(n_more, if (n_more == 1) " further ranked solution is" else " further ranked solutions are",
            " drawn only with ", tags$code("--embed full"), ". "),
  "Wakhan's interactive plots are not embedded in this report; they are in the pipeline output: ",
  tags$code("wakhan/solution_rank_N/integer_profile.html"), " per ranked solution, and the ploidy × purity heatmap ",
  tags$code(heatmap_name), ".")
```
